title: Strictification of a normal crossings boundary
statement: Let $F$ be an algebraically closed field and $V$ an integral regular finite-type $F$-scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-regular-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $Z\subset V$ be a normal crossings effective Cartier divisor [def-weil-closed-immersion]: etale locally [def-weil-etale-morphism] at every point it is cut out by a product of distinct members of a regular system of parameters. The empty divisor is allowed, and global components of $Z$ are allowed to have self-intersections. Then there is an integral smooth finite-type $F$-scheme $V_2$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and a proper $F$-morphism $q:V_2\to V$ [def-weil-proper-morphism], isomorphic over $V\setminus|Z|$ with dense inverse image of that open, such that $Z_2=(q^{-1}Z)_{\rm red}$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction] is a strict normal crossings divisor. Explicitly $Z_2$ is a reduced effective Cartier divisor with finitely many smooth irreducible components whose intersection for any $r$ distinct components is empty or smooth of codimension $r$ in $V_2$.

source.place: Expose VIII, 4.1.2--4.1.8, printed pp. 117--118: permissible blowups and Step 2 (strictification by maximal-multiplicity strata). The passage from regular strata to smooth strata over an algebraically closed field is Stacks 0B8X, varieties.tex, lemma-dense-smooth-open-variety-over-perfect-field; the normal-crossings intersection criterion is also explained in VIII, Remark 4.2.2(i).
